title: Raise the auto-compact window to 400k
body:
Outcome: operator 2026-11-01 (verbatim): "imo zmien na 400k póki co zeby sie swobodniej pracowało - potem jak juz wszystko bedzie zajebiscie rozwiniete i dzialajace to wrocimy do tematu". Set .claude/settings.json autoCompactWindow 200000 -> 400000 (gauge reads it since PR #152; advisories become 240k/320k) and update any text that names 120k/160k of 200k (krn-lead skill, rules).
Proof: context-gauge tests derive advisories from the configured window; git grep finds no stale 120k/160k/200k budget text.
